messages:
olivia: Heads-up — deploy button safety latch triggered for the canary rollout (usw2). deploy-bot reports auto-rollback threshold crossed (p95 > 600ms, error rate ~3%). Recommending allow auto-rollback, hold on pinning Dedicated pools until we confirm impact. @sam / @nina please ack.

deploy-bot: [AUTO-ROLLBACK] rollout=rl-2026-03-21-12 triggered. Rolling back to v3.6.1. Reason: p95 latency regression + error rate spike. Executing in 30s. To cancel/hold: `/deploy hold rl-2026-03-21-12`

sam: looking at traces now — spike aligns with the kvcache change merged in infra. +1 to rollback. I'll monitor. If rollback doesn't resolve within 5m we'll escalate.

nina: added trace logs to incident doc: https://redwood.incidents/INC-5889. Revert PR open: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/451 (kvcache flag). If rollback returns to baseline we can re-run canary with the flag off.

mike: flagging release notes freeze. Hold customer comms for 10m to see rollback outcome. If we see sustained customer-facing errors we'll send an update. @tara can you draft a short note now?

tara: Draft ready: "We've observed increased inference latency for a subset of requests during today's canary rollout. We're reverting to the previous stable release while we investigate. No action required from customers." Will queue but won't send until ops confirm. :thumbsup:

olivia: Deploy-bot initiated rollback. Command issued: `redwood deploy rollback --rollout rl-2026-03-21-12 --to v3.6.1 --reason \"canary p95 regression\"` Rollout link: https://deploy.redwood/rollouts/rl-2026-03-21-12

deploy-bot: [DONE] Rollback complete for rl-2026-03-21-12. Active version: v3.6.1. Canary health: p95=180ms, error=0.4%

sam: metrics back to baseline. Pausing canary for 1h. Will re-run with kvcache flag disabled and smaller traffic ramp. Leaving ticket open for postmortem.

nina: filing postmortem: PM-2222. Attaching traces, flamegraphs, and PR link.

olivia: Pinning Dedicated pools to v3.6.1 until investigation closes. Command: `redwood infra pin-dedicated --version v3.6.1 --scope eu,usw2` Release notes frozen until we validate next canary.

mike: I'll update the release notes draft to include rollback summary and next steps.

tara: Customer comm queued; will send only if we see customer impact or after we coordinate with support.

sam: TL;DR: rollback succeeded, canary paused, dedicated pinned, postmortem opened. Thanks all. :pray:
